chapter_seo_title: Departure – Li Huowang Plans His Return to Niuxin Village & Analyzes Doumu’s Gift
chapter_meta_description: Li Huowang talks to a tree, analyzes his new Zuowandao identity, and decides to head home. But a Siming’s gift is never free.
og_description: Li Huowang weighs the pros and cons of having his past rewritten by Doumu, then decides to head back to Niuxin Village for cultivation.
twitter_description: Li Huowang talks to trees, learns the full hallucination roster, and plans his return to Niuxin Village. Doumu’s waiting.

lore_anchors.definition: A high Daoist deity, Mother of the Big Dipper. In this novel, she is a Siming who controls all falsehood in the world. Every lie is a piece of her domain.
A rare human constitution that makes the bearer an object of desire for alchemists. Heart-Elements are prone to severe hallucinations and reality bleed.
A step above Heart-Element; a person whose belief is so strong it can reshape reality. More stable than Heart-Elements.
A high-dimensional entity in the Dao-Twisted World that governs a fundamental aspect of reality. Doumu is one.
A secret society of tricksters whose name means "The Way of Sitting in Forgetfulness." They steal falsehood from Doumu to fuel their powers.
The orthodox path of cultivation; grounding oneself in reality. Contrasts with the Zuowandao's "Cultivation of the False."
The collection of ghostly entities attached to Li Huowang as a result of his Heart-Element condition. Current count: seven total, five remaining.
A remote village where Bai Lingmiao and the rest of Li Huowang's found family are staying. A potential safe haven for cultivation.
